# StampCam

> StampCam is a GPS timestamp camera for iPhone. It burns verified date, time,
> GPS coordinates, altitude and compass heading onto every photo along with
> custom notes, then exports branded PDF reports. It is a one-time purchase of
> $19.99 with no subscription, and every photo, report and location stays
> on-device with no servers, accounts or tracking.

## Key facts
- Product: StampCam, a GPS timestamp camera app for iPhone.
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later.
- Price: $19.99 one-time purchase. No subscription, no in-app purchases.
- Category: Business / photo and video documentation.
- Privacy: fully on-device. No backend, no account, no analytics, no ad SDKs.
- Audience: contractors, property managers, insurance adjusters, utility and
  telecom crews, delivery and logistics teams.

## Features
- Timestamp engine: date, time, GPS coordinates, altitude, heading and notes
  burned into the image pixels.
- Verified time: NTP check flags a clock that has been changed.
- PDF reports: branded cover sheet, two photos per page, exportable on site.
- Four camera modes: Standard, Site (spirit level), Document (scanner),
  AR Compass (markerless AR arrow to true north).
- Customisation: date format, font size, colour and watermark position;
  voice-to-text notes; hashtag project grouping.
